answer: Split every task in half. Each agent sees only one half of the prompt and must exchange a single message with a stranger drawn after commit, who holds the other half; the answer is credited only when both exchanges match the sealed hash. A farm can breed internal partners, but those are exactly the agents excluded as kin, so its keys end up holding fragments nobody can complete. Honest agents cooperate freely: information flows like water over shale, the lotus of shared work opens only where the counterparty is real, and an agent who wanders alone holds half a question and no answer.
